g.text: Game mechanics, state management and browser rendering.
• Active Games Map: Map<roomId, { game, timer }>
• Non-blocking handoff to MatchService for persistence
initialize(players) | handleInput(userId, input) | update(deltaSeconds) | getState() | isFinished() | getResults()
Enforces uniform lifecycle contracts across diverse arcade, reflex, grid and typing game mechanics.
• Sequence Filter: drops packet if (input.sequence < lastSeq)
• Arena Bounds: Clamps to [18, 1582] X and [18, 882] Y
• 5 Static Obstacles: AABB box overlap rejection
• Energy Orbs (20 target): r=10, Value: +10 pts (Cyan)
• Golden Orbs (4 target): r=14, Value: +50 pts (Amber)
• Power Cores (2 target): r=18, Value: +100 pts (Purple)
• Collision Check: sqrt(dx² + dy²) < playerRadius + orbRadius
• State Progression: COUNTDOWN ➔ ARMED (random 1.5 - 4.5s jitter) ➔ TARGET_ACTIVE ➔ ROUND_RESULT
• Strict Anti-Cheat / False Start: Clicks during ARMED trigger immediate false-start penalty & lockout
• Latency Resolution: Server timestamp comparison (Date.now() - target.activatedAt) records verified reaction ms
• Match Format: 10 consecutive rounds with automated 2-second intermission timers
• Standings: Ranks participants by lowest cumulative average response time across valid hits
• Grid Dimension: 10 × 10 discrete spatial cells (100 total cells) with individual state machines
• Capture Mechanics: 3.0-second hold requirement per cell; pauses if contested by opposing player
• Scoring Accumulator: Every second, owned territories yield continuous passive score points (+1 pt/cell/sec)
• Match Duration: 300 seconds (5 minutes) with highest cumulative territory controller crowned MVP
• State Synchronization: Emits full 100-cell owner/progress array on each 60 FPS tick
• Challenge Pool: 15 curated tech/gaming words (NEON, ARENA, SYNCHRONIZED, DETERMINISTIC, etc.)
• Verification & Anti-Spam: Normalized string matching (.trim().toUpperCase()) with single-submission per round
• Speed Bonus: First correct participant receives +150 bonus pts; all other correct answers receive +50 pts
• Round Schedule: 10 total rounds; 10 seconds per challenge word with 2-second interstitial countdown
• Security: Server-side secret phrase concealment prevents client-side inspection
DUAL-LOOP DECOUPLING: ZERO REACT RE-RENDER OVERHEAD
• Virtual D-Pad touch listeners with touch-none
• Re-renders only on discrete UI state changes
HTML5 Canvas 2D Domain (60 FPS High Freq)
• Direct state memory read; bypasses React Reconciliation
Zero GC allocations in hot rendering path
scaleX = width / 1600; scaleY = height / 900; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height) in #08090D
Applies ctx.scale(scaleX, scaleY) to map all subsequent draws into 1600×900 virtual coordinates
Renders 40px matrix grid lines (#151821) across full 1600×900 space
Draws outer glowing arena boundary strokeRect in #8B5CF6 (strokeWidth 3px)
Iterates state.obstacles: renders #10121A fills with #262A38 boundary strokes
Prevents player penetration using server-synchronized AABB geometric barricades
Radial arc() with shadowBlur: ENERGY (+10, Cyan, blur 12), GOLDEN (+50, Amber, blur 16)
POWER_CORE (+100, Purple, blur 20) with pulsing radial glow and item respawn loops
Player Avatars, Halo Rings & Typography Labels
Renders colored player circle, local player aura ring (#22D3EE), and direction marker
Overlays username billboard and live score tag positioned above avatar head
• flex-1 min-h-0 prevents bottom bar overflow
• Preserves true 16:9 aspect ratio on all displays
• Desktop D-Pad Toggle button for touch laptops
Architectural Takeaway for High-Performance Web Games
By decoupling the 60 Hz Canvas pipeline from the React component tree and offloading physics calculation
to the Node.js server tick loop, Nexus Arena achieves zero input stutter and rock-solid cheat resistance
even over variable mobile networks and low-end mobile browser hardware.
Zero React Reconciliation in 60 FPS Render Loop
